coverage.note: Book 1 has title, author, genre, format, started, finished, pages, stars, reread, why I picked it up, my thoughts, favorite quote with page, favorite character and one-line review. Quotes page screenshotted; notes and notes2 exist in page_modules but have no screenshot.

The title opens 'Shelf Life Digital Reading Journal for Goodnotes'. Works with names Goodnotes, Notability, Samsung Notes, Xodo and Noteshelf on iPad, Android and Windows tablets. One PDF with plain GoTo links.
There are 4 Library pages of 25 lines, a TBR table, 12 month pages (m01 to m12) and the Reading year goal page.

coverage.where: index, every shot; PDF link scan
coverage.note: There is a Contents page. Month tabs are on every page. The Home, Library, TBR and Quotes bar is on every inner page. Book pages have previous and next arrows (b001 has next only, b100 previous only). 0 broken links and 0 unreachable pages.
Libre Baskerville headings and Manrope body are embedded. The page uses consistent rounded cards and a regular gutter and spacing. It looks finished, not like a template.
The Start here and Setup check instructions are printed inside the PDF.

coverage.where: files, listing.description How to start, photo-04, start step 1, cover
coverage.note: The product is a single file, Shelf-Life.pdf, 2.88 MB with no zip and no stickers. The listing and photo 4 give the 3 browser download steps, and Start here step 1 repeats them. The cover reads 'Shelf Life / Digital reading journal', which matches the first words of the listing title but not the full SEO title.
The Open journal link targets Start here. Start here has 4 numbered steps, each with a Go there button. Setup check is the next page. Start here and Setup check are the first two Contents cards.

coverage.where: b001..b100, m01..m12, tbr, listing What's inside
coverage.note: There are 100 numbered book pages, 12 undated month pages and a TBR list. The listing gives every page type with its count.

All book pages share one layout. Library numbers link to the books, and the trail links back to the right Library page (b026 goes to library2, b100 to library4). Start here step 3 walks through this loop.

coverage.where: PDF 576x768 pt, listing Works with / Not for
coverage.note: Pages are 3:4 portrait (768x1024 px at 96 dpi). All links are internal GoTo links. Not for covers phones, file viewers, spreadsheets and fillable forms. The Setup check page tests the links.

The link scan found 0 broken links and 0 unreachable pages. All fonts are embedded and text is vector. Book pages run in order, b001 at index 8 to b100 at index 107. Extracted words have no typos, and no overflowing text is visible.
Every photo is a render of the built pages with a page-name caption. The description says digital PDF, portrait only, undated, no stickers, and pen or text tool.
The file has 100 books plus 12 months, year, TBR, 2 quotes and 2 notes pages. Photo 2 shows the top of Book 1 large. The page count of 126 matches the PDF.

coverage.where: library Shelf column, b001 Genre/Format, start Tip, listing FAQ
coverage.note: The Shelf column is blank, Genre is a write-in line, and Format has Print, Ebook and Audio plus a blank option. Month pages show YEAR ____. The Start here tip and the listing explain the text tool and say it is not a fillable form.
Setup check has three jump buttons (month, year, Contents) and a four-item Nothing happened? fix list ending with messaging the shop.
The listing FAQ answers five questions: Etsy app download, which app, links not tapping, typing and landscape. Neither the file nor the listing promises reply times.
No stickers or covers are advertised. Page counts match the built file. Contents shows all 7 sections and 12 months on one screen.

coverage.where: library, library2-4 (page_modules), b001, b026 link scan
coverage.note: Each Library page has 25 numbered lines with title, author, finished, stars and shelf. Each number links to its book. The book trail returns to the right Library page, and the arrows step between books.

coverage.where: start = PDF page 3, linktest = PDF page 4, cover link
coverage.note: The page positions are confirmed in the PDF. The Go there buttons point to Contents, Setup check, Library and Reading year. Setup check has jump buttons and a fix list.
The year page has a goal line, 10 squares per month (tally past 10) with each month name linked to its page, fiction, nonfiction, print, ebook and audio tallies, a top 5 and a best quote.

Ivory paper #FBF7EF with ink #22304A at 12.4:1 contrast and muted text at 5.5:1. The oxblood #8C3B3B accent is on buttons and star outlines. Tabs run clay to blue with dark labels, headings are Baskerville and body is Manrope, with no florals or script. The brass bar appears on the cover, Contents and Start here but not on Setup check.

visual.issue: Photo 5's point 'Start here: 4 short steps' is not what the photo shows: the Start here crop shows only steps 1 and 2. This breaks r013 (points describe only what is in frame).
Photo 6's point says '12 undated month pages', but only January is in frame.
The hero point 'Goodnotes, Notability and Android' mixes two apps with a platform. It leaves out iPad, Samsung Notes, Xodo and Noteshelf.
The back tablet in the hero shows a Book 1 page that is mostly hidden behind the cover and has no caption.
Start here cards 2 and 4 are about 40% empty below their Go there buttons, and the bottom of cards 1 and 3 is empty too.
Step 1 'Open it in a note app' has a Go there button that only opens Contents. A buyer cannot tell why the button is in that step.
The eyebrow 'SETUP CHECK' repeats the title 'Setup check'. The 'Where things are' panel has large gaps between its 4 rows.
The Notes card sits alone in the third row of Contents, leaving two empty card slots.
The cover is about 70% empty paper above and below the title block.
The 'J' in the January and July titles hangs past the left text margin.
An empty band of about 100 px sits below the last TBR row inside the card.
Quotes page 2 and Notes page 2 have no previous arrow back to page 1, while book and month pages have both arrows.
The Reading year page runs January to December. A buyer starting in October to December cannot track a 12-month year from their start month on one page.
The brass detail is on Start here but missing on Setup check, the other guide page.
The bottom row is sliced by the crop edge in the Library and TBR crops.
